name: npcburst
description: Bulk NPC creation during travel, without a save (fresh start): peryite-flight flies north at running speed (340 u/s) along x = 148.8k, 9k units west of Peryite's Shrine (157.8k, -19.3k, cell 38,-5). When the player crosses the middle of cell row -7 (y = -26624) the old engine attaches row -5 and the GameThread creates the shrine's five worshippers (Er-Teeus, Kewan, Ilvel Romayn, Maren the Seal, Mirie; monk robes, a dagger) plus a wolf, a rat, a mudcrab and a slaughterfish: the same kind of burst as Sheogorath's Shrine on the Stendarr route, 4 frames of 40-97 ms (small profile). The burst is at y -26700 to -26300 of peryite-flight. (A Kvatch refugee-camp flight was tried and dropped: in a fresh game the camp's five refugees are not there.)

scenes.comment: North along x = 148.8k from y = -36k (cell row -9) to -20k at running speed; Peryite's Shrine (cell 38,-5) and its five worshippers are 9k units to the east. Expected burst when the player passes the middle of row -7 (y ~ -26.6k).
